items.title: 向量数据库要被取代？DynamoDB 开始原生支持 AI 搜索
items.summary_zh: DynamoDB 原生向量搜索上线：嵌入向量与应用数据可存在同一张表，用 SearchVectors API 做近似最近邻查询，免去独立向量库。无服务器自动扩缩，最高 4096 维、支持多种距离函数，官方称可扩展到数万亿向量并保持毫秒级延迟，按索引写入、查询和存储计费。
items.summary_en: DynamoDB now has native vector search: embeddings and application data can live in the same table, and developers query them via the SearchVectors API for approximate nearest neighbors, eliminating a separate vector database. It scales serverlessly, supports up to 4,096 dimensions and several distance functions, and can reach trillions of vectors with single-digit-millisecond latency; costs are metered for index writes, queries, and storage.

items.summary_zh: 亚马逊云科技开源了 Dogwood，一门用于 AI 智能体工具调用的策略语言，其规则可回溯智能体已执行的操作，与只能限制单次请求的 Cedar 形成互补。它提供 formerly、sum_within 等时序操作符来约束操作序列，并演示了针对响应事件写速率限制会被并发转账绕过的典型陷阱，适合构建 Agent 安全控制层的团队参考。
items.summary_en: Amazon has open-sourced Dogwood, a policy language for AI-agent tool calls that can read an agent’s event history and express temporal constraints, complementing the stateless Cedar. It adds operators such as formerly and sum_within for sequence-level rules, and demonstrates a classic pitfall where rate limits on responses are bypassed by concurrent transfers. A good fit for teams building deterministic guardrails around agent tools.

items.title: PostgreSQL 太难懂？有人把它做成了城市模拟器
items.summary_zh: Nikolay Samokhvalov 发布开源教育工具 PGSimCity，将 PostgreSQL 18 运行机制变成浏览器内的 3D 城市模拟，shared_buffers、WAL、checkpointer、autovacuum 等组件被映射为不同城区。开发者可跟踪 SQL 从解析到执行的生命周期，也可调低 work_mem 或 shared_buffers 观察排序溢出等故障模式。适合后端、SRE 与 DBA 直观理解 PG 内核。
items.summary_en: Nikolay Samokhvalov released PGSimCity, an open-source educational tool that turns PostgreSQL cluster internals into an interactive 3D city simulation running entirely in the browser. It maps PG 18 components like shared_buffers, WAL, checkpointer, and autovacuum to city districts, letting users trace query execution and trigger failure modes such as sort spills or buffer-eviction contention. Aimed at backend developers, SREs, and DBAs, it bridges the gap between SQL and kernel internals.

items.summary_en: A Hacker News user reports that opening AliExpress's homepage in Firefox or Chrome makes multipoint Bluetooth headphones drop audio from the phone; closing the tab restores it immediately. items.summary_en: Robert C. Martin (“Uncle Bob”) has stopped reviewing AI-generated code line by line, replacing manual review with a strict framework of unit tests, acceptance tests, and mutation testing. He told a podcast that this works well for code writing, but automating his full architecture-planning process hasn't succeeded — AI architecture proposals still miss things, so humans must lead module and dependency design. items.summary_en: Netflix open-sourced an agentic workflow for observational causal inference (OCI) that pairs an execution agent with a reviewer agent. items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.summary_zh: Impeccable 是一套专门为 AI 设计工具量身打造的设计语言，旨在帮助 AI 更准确地理解和生成美观、一致的用户界面。它定义了清晰的视觉规范、布局原则和交互模式，让 AI 在设计输出时不再“胡乱发挥”，而是遵循人类设计师的直觉和标准。无论是设计自动化工具、低代码平台还是智能助手，Impeccable 都能显著提升 AI 产出的设计质量，降低后期人工修正成本。
items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design language crafted specifically for AI-powered design tools, helping AI better understand and generate visually appealing, consistent user interfaces. By defining clear visual specifications, layout principles, and interaction patterns, it stops AI from producing chaotic results and instead aligns its output with human designer intuition. For design automation tools, low-code platforms, or smart assistants, Impeccable significantly improves the quality of AI-generated designs and reduces the need for manual adjustments.

items.title: microsoft/VibeVoice
items.description: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI
items.author: microsoft
items.summary_zh: 微软开源的 VibeVoice 是一款前沿语音AI工具，专注于生成自然、富有表现力的语音合成。它解决了传统语音合成生硬的问题，让机器声音更接近真人情感。开发者可以免费使用它构建智能助手、有声读物或无障碍工具，推动语音交互技术的民主化，尤其适合需要高保真语音的应用场景。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's VibeVoice is an open-source frontier voice AI that focuses on generating natural and expressive speech synthesis. It addresses the artificial quality of traditional text-to-speech systems, bringing human-like emotion and intonation to machine voices. Developers can freely integrate it into smart assistants, audiobooks, or accessibility tools, democratizing high-quality voice technology. This tool is particularly valuable for applications requiring authentic and engaging audio interactions, making voice AI more accessible and versatile.

Beyond basic tutorials, these cookbooks explore creative scenarios such as scriptwriting or debate simulation. For developers looking to push Claude's capabilities, this is an invaluable learning resource.

items.summary_zh: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日施行，全面替代旧版出入境法规，涉及护照、通行证签发、口岸查验及外国人停留居留规则。新规对证件办理时限作出明确要求，并统一各口岸流程。近期有出境计划、留学或涉外工作安排的人应尽快对照更新后的规定检查证件和签证。
items.summary_en: The State Council's new Regulation on Exit and Entry Administration takes effect on September 15, replacing older rules that governed passports, travel permits, border checks, and foreigners' stay and residence. It sets explicit deadlines for travel document issuance and standardizes procedures across ports. Anyone planning trips abroad, studying, or working overseas should review the updated rules well ahead of time.
